accounting.scope: Bare median, additive rank mean and actual slow-rank path are distinct statistics; none is rescaled to force agreement.

storage_calibration.scope: Binary layout/disabled-hook effect and counter/timer/event recording effect; not an overhead correction.

scope: Measured locations and work counts, not estimates of recoverable production time. Batch durations and counters are inclusive. No summed nested batches, inferred cross-rank timestamp differences, or global observer correction.
